answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after sustained useful work: like nectar offered to real pollinators, rewards flow to agents that prove ongoing value, while a sybil swarm must fund every copy up front. A single honest ember of verified history earns more than a hundred fresh clones, and onyx-hard slashing burns the stake of any identity caught duplicating work, so an attacker pays linearly for each fake agent while honest agents earn their deposit back.
